description: Gauge-invariant signed-volume validation at production scale. Tests gauge_invariant_signed_volume_3d() for exact gauge invariance under local gauge transformations at L=8,10,12,16.

results.keyFinding: Observable is EXACTLY gauge-invariant (|ΔQ| < 1e-10 under all transformations at all L). However, ⟨Q_GI⟩ → 0 as L → ∞ (0.011 at L=8 → 0.002 at L=16). NULL RESULT: not a useful order parameter — vanishes in thermodynamic limit.
results.physicalReview: The dressed correlator Q_GI = (1/N²) Σ s(r₁) W(r₁,r₂) s(r₂) with s(r) = path-ordered product from origin is exactly gauge-invariant by construction. However, at criticality the ensemble average vanishes because positive and negative contributions cancel. The observable does not discriminate confined vs deconfined phases at production scale.
results.conclusion: Gauge invariance CONFIRMED. Physical utility REJECTED. T31 closed with null result.
